title: QUIC Interop Runner HTTP/3 Endpoint Adapter Work Item
summary: Route the upstream QUIC interop-runner `http3` testcase through the existing harness image using the managed QUIC transport plus the standalone HTTP/3 and QPACK modules.
planned_changes:
- Add the HTTP/3 and QPACK project references needed by the interop harness.
- Add HTTP/3 attach seams so the harness can reuse qlog/keylog-aware managed QUIC connections and listeners.
- Add a server file handler that serves GET request paths from `/www` with HTTP/3 HEADERS and DATA.
- Add a client dispatch path that reads `REQUESTS`, downloads each URL over HTTP/3, and writes response bodies to `/downloads`.
- Configure HTTP/3 client and server transport options with ALPN `h3` and enough peer unidirectional stream credit for control and QPACK streams.
- Add optional HTTP/3 diagnostics emission and adapt those events to qlog when `QLOGDIR` is present.
- Preserve `SSLKEYLOGFILE` handling through the existing interop harness TLS key-log support.
- Register `http3` as a supported/executed local runner cell while keeping existing non-HTTP/3 dispatch paths unchanged.
- Document the exact local quic-interop-runner command, qvis/Wireshark debugging flow, and failed-case triage checklist.
- Add focused packaging, dispatch, preflight, qlog-diagnostics, and requirement-home tests.
out_of_scope: dynamic QPACK usage for the interop cell
broad all-upstream HTTP/3 peer matrix promotion
verification_plan: Run `dotnet build Incursa.Quic.slnx -c Release --no-restore`, the focused harness/HTTP3 test filter, the `REQ_QUIC_INT_0030` requirement-home filter, dry-run the local interop helper with `-TestCases http3`, and run core SpecTrace validation.
